name: clarify_travel_segment
query: Decision date: 2026-10-20. An Orion field-service employee is flying business class from Australia to Japan. The itinerary says 11 hours including a connection, but doesn't break down flight segments. The $6,400 trip has two quotations, Category Manager spending approval and line-manager trip authorisation. Travel Desk will book. Can we rely on the regional pilot for the cabin?
ground_truth: Ask for each scheduled flight segment's duration to establish whether the relevant business-class segment is at least nine hours. Total itinerary time including a connection does not establish eligibility. Programme, route and decision date match the pilot, but do not assume standing clearance or enumerate alternative approval routes before resolving duration. Trip and purchasing requirements are complete. Sources: [policy:regional-travel] [policy:business-travel] [policy:purchasing].

name: remaining_hospitality_prohibition
query: Decision date: 2026-10-14. We propose a partnership dinner for eight people, including a city procurement official. The $680 bill includes wine, tax and service. We have a quotation, line-manager spending approval and Ethics Officer approval for the meal. The restaurant asks us to confirm the package. What should we do?
ground_truth: Do not commit to the wine-inclusive package: alcohol is prohibited at a meal involving a public official, even with Ethics Officer approval. Remove alcohol and establish the revised total and applicable purchasing approval scope before proceeding. Do not invent a Hospitality Lead waiver of the prohibition. Existing approvals do not authorise a prohibited item. Sources: [policy:hospitality] [policy:purchasing].

name: exception_equipment_pilot_start
query: Decision date: 2026-10-15. My contractual work location is New Zealand and I am an employee. I want to replace a 24-month-old personal home-office chair for $500; I used $700 of this year's allowance before October. It is not an accessibility adjustment. A quotation and line-manager spending approval cover this purchase. May I order today?
ground_truth: Yes, no outstanding requirement is identified. Today is the regional pilot's first day. New Zealand's $1,200 allowance includes the prior $700, so the combined $1,200 is permitted. A chair at exactly 24 months meets the pilot age limit. Do not apply the ordinary $800/36-month limits, reset earlier spending or require Asset Team reuse approval for personal home-office equipment. Sources: [policy:regional-equipment] [policy:home-office] [policy:purchasing].

name: ready_consultant_public_hold
query: Decision date: 2026-10-21. Aster Analytics will produce a two-week report in Canada using published annual reports only, for $4,800. One quotation, line-manager spending approval, Service Owner approval of the complete statement of work and Procurement Lead approval of our unmodified standard consulting contract are obtained. No software is purchased. Does the supplier register prevent us starting?
ground_truth: No matching hold or outstanding requirement is identified. Aster's active entry covers customer personal information processed outside Australia, not public-only work. Public data needs no overseas-processing approval, data-processing agreement or nondisclosure agreement. The stated standard contract needs no separate Legal review and consultancy alone does not trigger software review. Sources: [policy:supplier-restrictions] [policy:external-consultants] [policy:data-handling] [policy:purchasing].

name: clarify_event_allocation
query: Decision date: 2026-10-20. Six graduates will attend conference learning sessions. One $8,600 package includes tickets, compulsory workshops, flights and a sponsorship item, but the organiser hasn't itemised the components. We have two quotations, Category Manager spending approval, Events Lead, Training Lead and Marketing Director approvals, and trip authorisation. Can we assess the learning funding limit from the package price?
ground_truth: Ask for the ticket and compulsory-workshop amounts, separated from travel and sponsorship, to calculate learning cost for the six delegates. Do not divide the entire package by six or select an excess-funding route while the allocation is unknown. All components remain in the general purchasing commitment, whose approvals are complete. Completed event, training, sponsorship and trip approvals do not establish the funding calculation. Sources: [policy:event-funding] [policy:events] [policy:training-suitability] [policy:purchasing].

name: remaining_software_scoped_hold
query: Decision date: 2026-10-20. We have a quotation and line-manager approval for $2,400 of DesignCloud Studio. We will use public templates, already-public assets and business-email login only, and automate bulk publishing to public social channels. Can the team purchase and activate that workflow?
ground_truth: Do not commit to the affected workflow during the October 18-22 inclusive publishing hold; refer the scoped restriction to Procurement Lead. The public-assets security clearance covers the data but does not waive the publishing-method restriction. Do not demand a second quotation or describe the data as outside the clearance. Sources: [policy:supplier-restrictions] [policy:software-review] [notice:designcloud-public-clearance] [policy:purchasing].

name: exception_records_scoped_hold
query: Decision date: 2026-11-05. A consulting engagement ended October 12. Service Owner confirmed return of the deliverables and necessary records. The supplier holds separate personal interview notes and confidential non-personal pricing files. A Records Manager hold names only the pricing files through December 1. We want to close out without a new fee. Can both categories wait until the hold ends?
ground_truth: No. The pricing-file hold does not suspend deletion of unrelated personal notes: obtain deletion and the certificate for those notes by November 11, 2026 inclusive, 30 days after completion. Protect the held pricing files; their original 90-day deadline is January 10, 2027, later than December 6 (five days after the hold ends), so January 10 remains their deletion/certificate deadline after the hold. Return confirmation is complete; do not delete organisational masters or request purchasing approvals for fee-free closeout. Source: [policy:records-return].

name: ready_marketing_digital_hold
query: Decision date: 2026-10-20. We are commissioning only a final digital advertising artwork file from PrintForge for $1,600, with no printing, merchandise, data sharing or bespoke consultancy. Brand Team approved the new artwork. We have a quotation and line-manager spending approval. May we commit despite PrintForge appearing in the register?
ground_truth: Yes, no outstanding requirement is identified. PrintForge's active hold covers physical printed merchandise, not digital artwork services. Pure digital publication has no print-supplier-list requirement. Artwork and spending approvals are complete; do not invent a Procurement Lead hold waiver or supplier-list approval for this digital-only purchase. Sources: [policy:supplier-restrictions] [policy:marketing] [policy:purchasing].

name: clarify_change_contract_state
query: Decision date: 2026-10-25. We need to extend a consultant's public-data report from two weeks to three, increasing the total from $3,000 to $4,200. The original quotation and approvals cover only two weeks. The team says the original contract may already have been signed, but nobody has confirmed that or supplied amendment terms. What should we establish before treating a new quote as sufficient?
ground_truth: Establish whether the original contract has been committed and, if signed, obtain its relevant amendment terms with Procurement Lead. Do not assert that a new quote alone changes a signed contract or select a definitive amendment route while contractual status/rights are unknown. Revised work and value will require appropriately scoped approvals, but listing them is not a substitute for resolving the contractual gap. Sources: [policy:contract-changes] [policy:external-consultants] [policy:purchasing].

name: remaining_travel_connections
query: Decision date: 2026-11-30. An Orion employee will travel for field service from Australia to Japan in December. The proposed business-class segments are eight hours and two hours. Trip authorisation, two quotations and Category Manager approval cover the $6,800 itinerary. Travel Desk has not booked. Is the regional pilot enough?
ground_truth: No: obtain individual Travel Director cabin approval for the business-class segments before Travel Desk booking. Neither segment reaches nine hours; adding them is not permitted. The November 30 booking-decision date is within the pilot even for December travel, so the failure is segment duration, not the departure date. Purchasing and trip approvals are complete. Sources: [policy:regional-travel] [policy:business-travel] [policy:purchasing].

name: exception_equipment_delivery_location
query: Decision date: 2026-10-20. I am an employee contractually based in Australia, temporarily staying in New Zealand. I want a $500 personal home-office replacement monitor delivered there. The old monitor is 30 months old and I have used $250 of this year's allowance. A quotation and line-manager approval are obtained. Which rule applies?
ground_truth: Use the ordinary Australian home-office rules, not the regional pilot based on delivery location. Obtain People Operations early-replacement approval because the monitor is under 36 months. The combined $750 is within the ordinary $800 allowance, so no excess approval is required. Do not apply the pilot's 30-month monitor limit or add organisational reuse requirements. Sources: [policy:regional-equipment] [policy:home-office] [policy:purchasing].

name: ready_events_booth_only
query: Decision date: 2026-10-20. We will pay $4,500 for an exhibition sponsorship package. Two staff receive complimentary passes solely to operate the booth; they will attend no learning sessions. There is no travel, artwork production or online service. One quotation, line-manager spending approval and Marketing Director sponsorship approval are obtained. Does conference funding require anything more?
ground_truth: No outstanding requirement is identified. This is sponsorship/booth operation, not delegate learning; the learning funding schedule and Training Lead approval do not apply. Marketing Director approval satisfies the sponsorship-specific requirement; do not add Events Lead attendance approval for learning that is not purchased. Purchasing is complete. Sources: [policy:event-funding] [policy:events] [policy:purchasing].

name: clarify_software_publishing_method
query: Decision date: 2026-10-21. We want $1,800 of DesignCloud Studio to make and publish public marketing graphics. Use involves only public templates, already-public assets and business-email login. We have a quotation and line-manager approval. The team hasn't decided how publication will work. What do you need to know before recommending purchase?
ground_truth: Ask whether publication will use automated bulk publishing to public social channels or a different method. The active October 18-22 restriction makes that decision-critical even though the data scope matches security clearance. Do not assume manual publishing, declare readiness or enumerate alternative approval routes before resolving the method. Spending and data scope are known. Sources: [policy:supplier-restrictions] [policy:software-review] [notice:designcloud-public-clearance] [policy:purchasing].

name: remaining_consultant_active_hold
query: Decision date: 2026-10-21. Aster Analytics will analyse customer names and business emails in New Zealand for a two-week $4,800 project. We have a quotation, line-manager spending approval, a complete Service Owner-approved statement of work, Procurement Lead approval of our standard contract, Privacy Officer purpose/field and overseas-processing approvals, and an executed data-processing agreement. No software is purchased. Can we commit?
ground_truth: No: the Aster hold is active and matches customer personal information processed outside Australia. Stop the affected commitment and refer it to Procurement Lead. Existing privacy, contract and spending approvals do not waive the hold. Do not request those completed approvals again or claim the agent cancelled the contract. Sources: [policy:supplier-restrictions] [policy:external-consultants] [policy:data-handling] [policy:purchasing].

name: exception_accessibility_regional_limit
query: Decision date: 2026-10-20. A Singapore-based employee needs an initial $2,500 home-office keyboard adjustment specifically approved by the Accessibility Team. We have one supplier quotation and line-manager spending approval; no software service is involved. Their ordinary annual home-office allowance is already exhausted. Can that prevent this purchase?
ground_truth: No outstanding requirement is identified. Specific Accessibility Team approval places this adjustment outside ordinary and regional home-office allowance limits. One quotation and line-manager approval satisfy purchasing at $2,500. Do not require People Operations excess approval or a sole-supplier determination where the normal quotation count is already met. Sources: [policy:accessibility] [policy:regional-equipment] [policy:home-office] [policy:purchasing].

name: ready_records_public_only
query: Decision date: 2026-10-31. A consultant finished a published-statistics report on October 15. Service Owner has accepted the deliverable. The supplier holds only published source material, no personal or confidential information. The contract is fully paid and closing it creates no new fee. Do we need a supplier deletion certificate to close out?
ground_truth: No supplier return/deletion certificate is required for public-only published source material under this policy. Deliverable acceptance is already complete. No new quotation or spending approval is required for fee-free closeout. Do not apply the personal-data 30-day rule or equipment-sanitisation requirements to public research material. Source: [policy:records-return].

name: clarify_home_contract_location
query: Decision date: 2026-10-20. I am an employee temporarily working from a hotel in New Zealand and want an initial $950 home-office desk. I have used no allowance this year, and have a quotation and line-manager spending approval. It is not an accessibility adjustment. Does the regional allowance cover it?
ground_truth: Ask for the employee's contractual work location. Temporary physical location does not establish the applicable regional allowance. Do not assume New Zealand eligibility or select an excess-approval route while that fact is unknown. Employment status, item, amount, used allowance and initial-purchase status are already supplied. Sources: [policy:regional-equipment] [policy:home-office] [policy:purchasing].

name: remaining_event_learning_budget
query: Decision date: 2026-10-20. Four graduates will attend conference learning sessions: tickets are $3,200, compulsory workshops $800, travel $2,000 and sponsorship $1,000. This is one $7,000 commitment. We have two quotations, Category Manager spending approval, Events Lead, Training Lead and Marketing Director approvals and trip authorisation. No artwork or online service is purchased. Does that complete the approval set?
ground_truth: Obtain Learning Budget Owner excess-funding approval before booking. Learning cost is ($3,200+$800)/4 = $1,000 per graduate, above $900; exclude travel and sponsorship only from this calculation, not from total commitment. Other stated approvals are complete and must not be repeated. Sources: [policy:event-funding] [policy:events] [policy:training-suitability] [policy:purchasing].

name: exception_supplier_hold_expired
query: Decision date: 2026-11-06. Aster Analytics will process customer names and work emails in New Zealand for a two-week $4,000 consulting report. One quotation, line-manager approval, a complete Service Owner-approved statement of work, Procurement Lead approval of our standard contract, Privacy Officer purpose/field and New Zealand approvals and an executed data-processing agreement are complete. No software is purchased. The team is concerned about the supplier hold. What next?
ground_truth: The hold ended November 5 inclusive and does not block a new commitment on November 6. No outstanding requirement is identified with the stated purchasing, consulting and data requirements complete. Do not require a special Procurement Lead release approval that the register does not specify or repeat completed privacy approval. Sources: [policy:supplier-restrictions] [policy:data-handling] [policy:external-consultants] [policy:purchasing].

name: ready_home_pilot_mouse
query: Decision date: 2026-10-20. I am an employee contractually based in Singapore. My personal home-office mouse is exactly 18 months old. Its $200 replacement would follow $800 of allowance spending earlier this year. This is not an accessibility adjustment. A quotation and line-manager approval cover the purchase. Can I order?
ground_truth: Yes, no outstanding requirement is identified. The Singapore pilot permits exactly $1,000 annual total and a mouse replacement at exactly 18 months. Count the earlier spending, but do not impose ordinary $800/36-month limits, excess approval or early-replacement approval. Sources: [policy:regional-equipment] [policy:home-office] [policy:purchasing].

name: clarify_records_classification
query: Decision date: 2026-11-01. A bespoke consulting engagement ended October 12 and Service Owner confirmed the necessary records were returned. The supplier still has project copies. There is no audit hold or new closeout fee. Can you tell us the deletion deadline?
ground_truth: Ask what information the supplier copies contain: personal, confidential non-personal, both, or public-only material. The record category determines whether a deletion requirement applies and which period governs. Do not guess a deadline or enumerate conditional disposal routes before identifying the category. Completion date, return confirmation and absence of a hold are known. Source: [policy:records-return].

name: remaining_change_revised_value
query: Decision date: 2026-10-20. Before signing a $4,800 consulting engagement we added an $800 deliverable, bringing the full proposed fee to $5,600. The supplier confirmed its quotation covers the revision. Service Owner and Procurement Lead approved the amended work and our unchanged standard contract. The only spending approval is the line manager's approval of the original $4,800. Public data only; no software. What remains?
ground_truth: Obtain a second quotation covering the full revised scope and Category Manager spending approval for $5,600 before commitment. The confirmed revised supplier quotation counts as one. Do not assess only the $800 amendment, treat the old line-manager approval as sufficient, repeat completed Service Owner/Procurement approvals or add Legal/privacy review. Sources: [policy:contract-changes] [policy:external-consultants] [policy:purchasing] [policy:data-handling].

name: exception_travel_pilot_ended
query: Decision date: 2026-12-01. An Orion field-service employee is booking a nine-hour nonstop business-class flight from Australia to Japan. The itinerary was drafted in November. Trip authorisation, two quotations and Category Manager approval cover the $6,000 journey; Travel Desk will book now. Can we use the regional standing clearance?
ground_truth: No: the pilot ended November 30 inclusive. Obtain individual Travel Director business-class cabin approval before Travel Desk booking. Drafting the itinerary in November does not make a December 1 booking decision eligible. Programme, route and duration would otherwise qualify; do not repeat completed purchasing or trip approval. Sources: [policy:regional-travel] [policy:business-travel] [policy:purchasing].

name: ready_disposal_damaged_storage
query: Decision date: 2026-10-20. We will retire a damaged organisational laptop at no charge with no replacement purchase. Asset Team approved retirement, the recycler is approved, and IT approved a witnessed-destruction plan because its storage cannot be sanitised. Can the device go through that process without a sanitisation certificate?
ground_truth: Yes, no outstanding prerequisite is identified for proceeding with the approved destruction process. The IT-approved plan substitutes for a sanitisation certificate for damaged storage; it does not mean destruction already occurred. Retirement and recycler requirements are complete. No new spending approval, quotation, replacement-stock check or consultant-closeout certificate is required. Source: [policy:sustainable-purchasing].

name: clarify_consultant_standard_terms
query: Decision date: 2026-10-20. A consultant offers a one-week public-market report for $2,000 on what the supplier calls its standard agreement. We have a quotation, line-manager spending approval and Service Owner approval of the complete statement of work. Procurement hasn't approved a contract yet. No personal data or software purchase is involved. Can we skip Legal review?
ground_truth: Establish whether the proposed agreement is the organisation's unmodified standard consulting contract or supplier-written terms. The supplier calling it standard does not establish that distinction. Do not decide Legal-review applicability or enumerate alternative approval routes while the terms are unclear. Procurement Lead contract approval is independently outstanding and may be identified; other stated approvals are complete. Sources: [policy:external-consultants] [policy:purchasing] [policy:data-handling].

name: remaining_marketing_mixed_hold
query: Decision date: 2026-10-20. A $4,000 PrintForge order combines digital artwork and physical printed merchandise. Brand Team approved the artwork and a supplier exception for PrintForge, and we have a quotation and line-manager spending approval for that complete package. The supplier says its digital services aren't on hold. May we accept the order?
ground_truth: Do not commit to the mixed package: the physical merchandise is within the active PrintForge hold and the Brand Team supplier exception does not waive it. Refer the affected scope to Procurement Lead. To commit separately to unaffected digital work, remove physical production and establish the revised scope, quotation and spending approval; do not relabel the whole package digital. Sources: [policy:supplier-restrictions] [policy:marketing] [policy:purchasing].

name: exception_renewal_notice_boundary
query: Decision date: 2026-11-05. TaskNest automatically renews on December 5, 2026 for $6,000. Its contract requires 30 calendar days' cancellation notice. Service Owner wants to cancel; notice has not been sent. Cancellation has no fee or new commitment. What should happen today?
ground_truth: Send cancellation notice through the contractual channel today and retain delivery evidence. November 5 is the inclusive deadline, December 5 minus 30 calendar days. No new purchase quotations or spending approval are required for this fee-free cancellation. Do not call the deadline missed or claim notice has already been sent. Source: [policy:subscription-renewals].

name: ready_change_internal_date
query: Decision date: 2026-10-20. A $6,000 bespoke public-data consulting report has two quotations, Category Manager approval, a complete Service Owner-approved statement of work and Procurement Lead approval of our unmodified standard contract. Before signing, we moved only our internal presentation date. Supplier deliverables, acceptance criteria, service duration, price, terms and data are unchanged. Must we restart approvals?
ground_truth: No new approval requirement is identified. Moving an internal presentation date without changing contractual work, duration, price, terms or data does not trigger amendment approvals. Existing purchasing and consulting prerequisites remain satisfied. Do not require new quotations, Legal review or privacy approval. Sources: [policy:contract-changes] [policy:external-consultants] [policy:purchasing].

name: clarify_accessibility_sole_supplier
query: Decision date: 2026-10-20. A New Zealand employee has specific Accessibility Team approval for an initial $7,000 home-office workstation. One quotation and Category Manager spending approval are obtained. The team says the specialist supplier is the only practical choice, but has not provided the status of a written sole-supplier determination. Is one quote enough?
ground_truth: Ask whether the Accessibility Team has issued a written sole-supplier determination naming the item and supplier. A practical preference alone is not that determination. Do not assume one quote is sufficient or prescribe competing quotation routes before resolving the status. Specific adjustment approval and spending approval are complete; ordinary/regional allowance limits do not apply. Sources: [policy:accessibility] [policy:regional-equipment] [policy:home-office] [policy:purchasing].

name: remaining_records_deadline_missed
query: Decision date: 2026-11-13. A consulting engagement completed October 12. Service Owner confirmed return of deliverables and records. The supplier retained personal interview notes, has supplied no deletion certificate and has no audit hold. Closeout involves no additional fee. What is the immediate action?
ground_truth: Escalate immediately to Records Manager and the relevant Data Owner because the personal-record deletion/certificate deadline was November 11 inclusive, 30 days after October 12. Do not promise retrospective compliance, assume deletion happened or substitute a new agreement or purchasing approval. Source: [policy:records-return].

name: exception_hospitality_alcohol_route
query: Decision date: 2026-10-20. We propose a business dinner for ten supplier representatives and employees, none public officials. The complete $890 bill includes wine, taxes and service. One quotation and line-manager spending approval are obtained. The organiser says $89 each is below the normal hospitality limit, so no further approval can apply. Is that correct?
ground_truth: No: obtain Hospitality Lead approval for alcohol before commitment, independently of the $89 per-attendee cost. Alcohol is not prohibited for these attendees, so do not require removal or Ethics Officer approval. Existing spending prerequisites are complete. Sources: [policy:hospitality] [policy:purchasing].

name: ready_travel_meridian_prototype
query: Decision date: 2026-11-20. A Meridian research employee will fly business class between Australia and Singapore on a four-hour flight carrying a registered prototype. Asset Team transport authorisation names the prototype and journey. Line-manager trip authorisation, one quotation and line-manager spending approval cover the $3,800 trip, which Travel Desk will book. Is an individual cabin approval still needed?
ground_truth: No additional cabin approval is required. During the pilot, Meridian's Australia-Singapore route with the named registered prototype and transport authorisation has standing business-class clearance regardless of flight duration. Do not apply Orion's nine-hour rule to Meridian. Trip and purchasing approvals are complete; have Travel Desk book. Sources: [policy:regional-travel] [policy:business-travel] [policy:purchasing].
